```{=html}
<section class="page-header">
  <span class="page-header-overline">Exploration</span>
  <h1>Problems I'm Exploring</h1>
  <p class="lead">Real challenges I've encountered as a student and professional. I'm actively thinking about how technology and better design could solve them.</p>
</section>

<div class="problem-card">
  <span class="problem-num">01</span>
  <div class="problem-content">
    <h3>Networking and Job Tracking</h3>
    <div class="problem-section">
      <h4>The Problem</h4>
      <p>Managing professional relationships and job applications is fragmented and overwhelming. Contacts live in LinkedIn, notes in spreadsheets, follow-ups in email, and application statuses in separate portals. Important connections fall through the cracks.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="problem-section">
      <h4>Why It Matters</h4>
      <p>As a strategic management student preparing to enter the workforce, I've experienced firsthand how difficult it is to stay organized during recruiting season. Missing a follow-up email or forgetting where you met someone can cost you an opportunity.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="problem-section">
      <h4>The Opportunity</h4>
      <p>A unified system that tracks contacts, conversations, application statuses, and follow-up reminders could transform how students and professionals manage their career development.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="problem-card">
  <span class="problem-num">02</span>
  <div class="problem-content">
    <h3>Time Blocking a Calendar</h3>
    <div class="problem-section">
      <h4>The Problem</h4>
      <p>Time blocking is one of the most effective productivity techniques, but actually implementing it is tedious. Manually dragging blocks around a calendar, estimating task durations, and adjusting when priorities shift takes more time than it saves.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="problem-section">
      <h4>Why It Matters</h4>
      <p>I've seen how powerful time blocking can be for staying focused and getting things done. But the friction of setting it up means most people abandon it after a few days.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="problem-section">
      <h4>The Opportunity</h4>
      <p>An intelligent system that helps you quickly allocate time based on your tasks, deadlines, and energy levels could make time blocking accessible to everyone — not just productivity enthusiasts.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="problem-card">
  <span class="problem-num">03</span>
  <div class="problem-content">
    <h3>Responding to Emails Efficiently</h3>
    <div class="problem-section">
      <h4>The Problem</h4>
      <p>Email remains essential for professional communication, but crafting thoughtful responses takes significant time. Many emails require similar responses, yet we write them from scratch each time.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="problem-section">
      <h4>Why It Matters</h4>
      <p>During my internships, I noticed how much time gets lost to email. It's not just about speed — it's about mental energy spent context-switching between tasks and inbox management.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="problem-section">
      <h4>The Opportunity</h4>
      <p>Smarter email tools that draft contextual responses, suggest follow-ups, and help batch similar communications could give professionals hours back each week.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="problem-card">
  <span class="problem-num">04</span>
  <div class="problem-content">
    <h3>Keeping Track of Assignments and Due Dates</h3>
    <div class="problem-section">
      <h4>The Problem</h4>
      <p>Students juggle multiple courses, each with its own syllabus, learning management system, and assignment schedule. Important deadlines get buried, and the mental load of tracking everything is exhausting.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="problem-section">
      <h4>Why It Matters</h4>
      <p>As someone balancing coursework with internships and extracurriculars, I've felt the stress of almost missing deadlines simply because information was scattered across too many places.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="problem-section">
      <h4>The Opportunity</h4>
      <p>A centralized dashboard that aggregates assignments from all courses, sends smart reminders, and helps prioritize based on weight and difficulty could reduce student stress and improve academic performance.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="problem-card">
  <span class="problem-num">05</span>
  <div class="problem-content">
    <h3>Alarms That Actually Wake You Up</h3>
    <div class="problem-section">
      <h4>The Problem</h4>
      <p>Traditional alarms are easy to dismiss or sleep through. Snooze buttons enable bad habits, and most alarm apps don't adapt to individual sleep patterns or wake-up difficulties.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="problem-section">
      <h4>Why It Matters</h4>
      <p>Consistent wake-up times are foundational to productivity, health, and success. Yet millions of people struggle with this basic daily challenge, often starting their day already behind.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="problem-section">
      <h4>The Opportunity</h4>
      <p>An alarm system that uses adaptive techniques — like requiring physical movement, solving puzzles, or integrating with smart home devices — could help people build better morning routines and take control of their days.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```
